title: How the first session captures were taken, sealed and machine-checked

read_window_utc.evidence: start = the session's first page fetch of the registered sources; end = the last chunk fetch (the injury report was read in 8 chunks in one pass, then the transactions hub, reserve list and club depth page). The fetch tool exposes no per-call clock, so windows — not per-read timestamps — are recorded (SUG-12 A convention). The CI collector replaces this limitation with real HTTP clocks from its first run.
read_window_utc.game_context: Week 10 Thursday and Sunday games completed; the Monday Nov 16 LAC@BAL game had not kicked off at read time

method.how: each page fetched with the page-fetch tool, rendered as markdown, and every printed table row transcribed in page order into the transcript files in data/captures/2026-11-16/; engine/transcribe.py parses the transcripts mechanically into the capture JSONs (never hand-edited); chunk-boundary rows were reconstructed from the two printed halves of the row and are marked in the transcript comments
method.what_is_hashed: each capture records the sha256 of its transcript files (the evidence as fetched); raw HTML bytes are never committed (RF-18 held open for the owner)
method.rights_note: the captures store structured facts + hashes + timestamps, not page copies; the public site renders only the derived analysis and links back to the official pages

machine_checks_run: engine/transcribe.py: vocabulary + required-field checks on every row (fail on violation)
engine/drift.py: all pins from data/drift_expectations.json hold (347/28/14 rows-clubs-sections, per-club counts, practice tallies 94/180/73, 171 designated rows = 49.3% coverage)

engine/drift.py: field-by-field reconciliation vs BOTH peer captures of the same report (nfl-availability-desk 2026-11-15 CSV: 0 differences; nfl-book 2026-11-16 JSON: 0 differences beyond the documented AZ/ARI club-code alias)
engine/collect.py --verify: ledger hash chain recomputed from genesis, matches chain_head
irregularities_found: the live page's week control still lists WEEK 10 only on Monday 2026-11-16; the Week 11 URL (reg11) cannot be verified until the page exists (RC-03)
the three dated reads of the Week 10 report are field-identical (0 deltas) — the report is a weekly artifact; deltas begin with the Week 11 practice cycle (RC-06)
the rendered November reserve table begins at 11/07; IR placements dated 11/05–11/06 (e.g. Lamar Jackson, per the league's own news article) are not visible and are not filled from anywhere (RC-04)
